metaDescription: Keep drinks cold with custom insulated koozies. Perfect for events and promotions. Order bulk from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Insulated koozies keep beverages colder longer than standard neoprene sleeves, making them a practical giveaway for outdoor events, tailgates, and corporate picnics. Whether you choose a slim can cooler for 12 oz cans or a tall boy design for 16 oz or 24 oz cans, the foam or fabric insulation provides superior temperature retention. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery to create a useful branded item that recipients will reach for again and again.
heroAltText: Custom insulated koozies with logo, keeping drinks cold at a summer event
